headline: Al-Shal: KD 2.13 billion liquidity in Kuwait Stock Exchange in 8 months
summary: Kuwait Stock Exchange liquidity reached KD 2.13 billion in the first eight months of the year, according to the Al-Shal weekly report. Average daily trading value was KD 83 million.
why: The Kuwait Stock Exchange is the country's main equity market, and trading liquidity indicates investor activity in Kuwaiti equities.
